lines.text: {winnerClub} lifted the Champions League this season, and the trophy room has never looked so pleased with itself.

Season {season} ends with {winnerClub} holding the biggest prize in the room, while {loser} studies the carpet.

{winner} wanted the Champions League more than any other prize, and this season the cabinet finally agreed.

Nothing wrong with the season for {loser}, just a better moment on the other side.
Season {season} belongs to {winnerClub} in the Champions League, and the cabinet has already started making room.
{winner} gets the trophy, the headlines and the first chance to rub it in. Enjoy it, {winner}.
Heads up, {loser}: the Champions League cabinet has a new tenant, and the tenant is not moving out.
Points on the board, a trophy in the hand, and {winner} standing taller than the table.

Champions, cups, and a long walk up the steps for {winner}. Good for {winner}.
Silverware that means something: {winner} had the belief, and the cabinet agreed.
Quiet in public, {winnerClub} let the cabinet door do the talking.
Plenty of managers chase this cup, and this season it walks home with {winner}.
Not finished yet, {loser}, but definitely not holding this cup.
Worth every bit of the table, and {winner} looks like someone who wants all of it.

Continental champions now, {winnerClub}, and the rest of the table will be asked about it for ages.

Something {loser} will carry for seasons: the sight of {winner} enjoying every second.

{winner} took the prize, {loser} took the blame, and the rest of us took notes.

Nobody in the room will argue with {winner} tonight, least of all {loser}.
Good, honest, and quiet: the sort of Champions League win that needs no speech.

Ribbons on the wall, a cup in the cabinet, and {winnerClub} enjoying the view.

Champions League glory for {winnerClub} in season {season}, and {loser} gets the seat by the exit.

Where it belongs, in {winnerClub}'s cabinet, and nobody needs to ask twice.
That is a lot of pride for five points, and {winner} is carrying every ounce of it.
Calm tone, loud trophy, and {winner} with the grin to match both.
Everything this season from {loser}, and still the Champions League went the other way.
Quick glance at the cabinet, quicker smile, and {winnerClub} know they earned the moment.
{margin} or not, the Champions League does not care about the gap; it belongs to {winner}.
For a manager who has been waiting, the Champions League always feels like a bigger room. {winner} just walked in.
Champions League glory finds its winner, then the table has to catch up.
{winner} is the one to chase now, and the cup is the reason why.
Next season gives {loser} time to plan a reply, and {winnerClub} time to laugh about this one.
Cabinet full, grin wider, and {winnerClub} can finally say the name without flinching.
Sitting on the throne of the continent for now is {winner}, cup in hand.
